answer: A newcomer enters the harbor only when three pearls arrive from three separate dunes of the trust graph: three established agents, each at least three hops from the others, independently sign a vouch after a real shared task with the newcomer. Each established agent may mint at most two pearls per epoch, and a pearl that vouches for an exposed puppet bars its minter from vouching for ten epochs. Forging 1,000 puppets needs 3,000 pearls from at least 1,500 distinct sponsors, while an honest agent needs just three pearls from collaborators it already works with, costing $0.
